dimensional.title: Measure. Compare. Verify.
dimensional.description: We utilize Coordinate Measuring Machines (CMM) for tactile inspection of linear dimensions, form, and complex geometric tolerances. With the ZEISS DuraMax, we handle general-tolerance projects (≥ 0.02 mm). For tighter requirements and high-demand geometries, we deploy the ultra-high-precision ZEISS PRISMO.

optical.title: High-resolution non-contact measurement.
optical.description: Using the ZEISS O-Inspect, we inspect sensitive parts and components that cannot undergo mechanical probing. The system combines optical and tactile measurement, alongside the DotScan sensor, capable of capturing the topography of reflective, transparent, or hard-to-read surfaces.

xray.title: See what cannot be seen.
xray.description: With ZEISS Bosello, we perform non-destructive testing to evaluate internal structures and discontinuities invisible to conventional methods, identifying defects based on material density.

scanning.title: Transform physical geometry into digital data.
scanning.description: We capture complex geometries to produce high-fidelity 3D models for dimensional analysis, quality control, and reverse engineering. The T-SCAN Hawk 2 provides portable flexibility for on-site measurement, while the ATOS Q delivers maximum point density for intricate components.

applications.fieldScanning: Portable scanning on-site or on the shop floor

reverse.title: From physical part to parametric CAD model.
reverse.description: We reconstruct exact component geometries from point clouds and 3D meshes, delivering solid or surface CAD models ready for manufacturing, replacement, or design optimization.

cmm.title: Coordinate Measuring (CMM) & GD&T
cmm.headline: Sub-micrometric accuracy for critical geometries and rigorous geometric compliance.
cmm.overview: Service dedicated to 3D geometric and linear characterization of high-demand mechanical parts. Utilizing continuous-contact CMM systems (tactile scanning), we evaluate form, orientation, and location deviations according to ISO 1101 and ASME Y14.5 standards.
targetAudience: Precision machining and die & mold making facilities
Automotive OEMs and Tier 1 / Tier 2 suppliers
Aerospace and defense industries requiring formal traceability
Serial parts manufacturers requiring First Article Inspection (FAI)
applications: Dimensional and linear inspection of engine blocks and housings
First Article Inspection (FAI) validation of machined components
Process repeatability and capability studies (Cp, Cpk)
deliverables: Nominal vs. actual numerical comparison with tolerance bands
Certificate of conformity signed by the technical lead

machines.name: ZEISS PRISMO
machines.software: ZEISS CALYPSO with VAST Navigator, VAST Probing & FlyScan
features: Zerodur®/Robax® glass-ceramic scales with 200 nm resolution impervious to thermal expansion
Computer-Aided Accuracy (CAA) for dynamic error correction during high-speed scanning (up to 300 mm/s)
ZEISS VAST Performance package with FlyScan (up to 70% cycle reduction) and QuickChange stylus system
C99m controller with automatic energy and compressed air shutdown (PowerSaver & AirSaver)

machines.name: ZEISS DuraMax
features: 100% all-electric operation with no compressed air supply required
Glass-ceramic scales guaranteeing thermal stability from 18 °C to 30 °C
ShopFloor base structure with IP54 dust and splash sealing
Ergonomic 3-sided and overhead part loading

optica.title: Combined Optical & Tactile Inspection
optica.headline: High-resolution non-contact measurement for flexible components and micro-geometries.
optica.overview: Integrates high-definition optical cameras with telecentric lenses and continuous tactile probing on a single machine. Eliminates contact pressure deformation on elastomers, thin polymers, technical textiles, and electronic circuits.
targetAudience: Medical device, implant, and prosthesis manufacturers
Thin-walled injection molded plastic parts manufacturers
Electronics and precision micro-connector industries
Technical textile and polymer packaging sectors
applications: Non-contact inspection of micro-holes and sharp edges
Evaluation of micro-deformations and radii on elastic components
Rapid 2D/3D combined measurement in a single setup without reclamping
deliverables: Optical dimensional analysis report with magnified images
2D contour deviation maps against vector drawings (DXF/CAD)
Technical certificate of edge and profile conformity

machines.name: ZEISS O-INSPECT
machines.sensor: ZEISS Discovery.V12 Camera + VAST XXT Contact Sensor
features: ZEISS Discovery.V12 zoom lens with 4× wider field of view and zero peripheral distortion
Versatile illumination system with 4 concentric rings and blue/red LEDs across 8 independent segments
Continuous tactile probing with VAST XXT supporting star and radial stylus configurations
Ready for coupling with ZEISS DotScan chromatic white light sensor
Pneumatic vibration isolation against ground structural vibrations

raio-x.title: X-Ray Inspection & Structural Analysis
raio-x.headline: Internal volumetric investigation and integrity verification without sectioning or destroying samples.
raio-x.overview: 2D radioscopic inspection and non-destructive tomography to identify hidden internal discontinuities. Evaluates cast components, welds, and sealed assemblies based on material density and radiological absorption.
targetAudience: Aluminum, cast iron, and specialty alloy foundries
Manufacturers of critical welded assemblies for energy and oil & gas
Assemblers of sealed or shielded electromechanical devices
Forensic engineering and warranty failure analysis labs
applications: Detection of internal porosities, gas voids, shrinkage cavities, and cracks
Inspection of weld root penetration and quality
Component positioning verification inside sealed enclosures
Mapping of metallurgical inclusions and discontinuities
deliverables: High-resolution digital radiographs with defect and void identification
Porosity analysis report compliant with industrial standards

machines.name: ZEISS BOSELLO MAX
machines.volume: Inspection cylinder Ø 700 × 1200 mm up to Ø 1000 × 2000 mm | Parts up to 250 kg
machines.accuracy: High-resolution microfocus for submillimeter crack, void, and porosity detection
machines.sensor: 8" to 16" digital Flat Panel detector + High-penetration X-ray tube (160 to 450 kV)
machines.software: ZEISS Bosello Integrated Software / ZEISS INSPECT X-Ray (CT-Ready)
features: High penetration capability for light aluminum alloys and cast iron/steel parts up to 50 mm thick
360° rotary table extending outside the cabinet doors for ergonomic crane/forklift loading
Exclusive software-controlled virtual C-arm configuration for precise source-detector alignment
CT-Ready: prepared for tomographic scan acquisition and 3D reconstruction with defect spatial analysis
Automated CNC inspection cycles and Automatic Defect Recognition (ADR) according to ASTM standards
Self-contained cabinet with fully integrated radiation shielding and real-time operator viewing

digitalizacao-3d.title: 3D Optical Scanning & Color Map Analysis
digitalizacao-3d.headline: Full-field non-contact geometric capture for dimensional inspection and tooling verification.
digitalizacao-3d.overview: High-density 3D digitization using structured blue light and portable laser triangulation. Generates high-fidelity point clouds for full-surface comparison against the nominal CAD model.
targetAudience: Automotive OEMs, stamping plants, and progressive die tooling makers
Foundries and forging facilities for medium-to-large components
Footwear, packaging, and consumer products with complex organic geometries
Quality control teams requiring on-site shop floor inspection
applications: Full 3D deviation color-map reports (Nominal CAD vs. Actual Scan)
Rapid inspection of warpage, twist, and spring-back
In-situ scanning of large components that cannot be moved
Generation of watertight polygonal STL meshes for dimensional control
deliverables: 3D color map deviation report illustrating excess and deficient material zones
Cleaned, aligned polygon mesh (STL, OBJ, PLY)
Full freeform surface dimensional deviation report

machines.name: ZEISS ATOS Q
machines.accuracy: Point spacing from 0.03 to 0.15 mm | Resolution up to 2 × 12 million points per scan
machines.sensor: Stereoscopic cameras with Blue Light Equalizer and Triple Scan Principle
features: Triple Scan Principle: captures 3 distinct perspectives per shot, ideal for shiny, reflective, and undercut areas
Blue Light Equalizer with ultra-fast fringe projection insensitive to ambient workshop lighting
Sealed 4 kg housing resistant to dust and splashes for reliable shop floor operation
Ultra-high-speed data transmission over a 10-meter fiber optic cable
Tripod manual operation or semi-automated inspection on the motorized GOM ROT 350 rotary table

machines.name: ZEISS T-SCAN hawk 2
machines.volume: Flexible and scalable volume: from small components to multi-meter structures via Satellite Mode
machines.accuracy: Volumetric accuracy 0.02 mm + 0.015 mm/m (acceptance test based on ISO 10360)
machines.sensor: Multiple blue laser crosses + dedicated single line for deep channels and pockets (Eye-safe Class 2)
features: Innovative Satellite Mode: large object scanning without separate photogrammetry or coded target setups
Integrated distance radar with red laser projection for real-time optimal working distance feedback
Ultralight ergonomic design (< 1 kg) with complete 4-button handle control without touching the computer
Proven traceability with DAkkS-calibrated carbon fiber length artifacts (ISO/IEC 17025)
Rapid single-shot on-site recalibration using the precision HyperScale bar
High performance on dark, reflective, or machined surfaces without mandatory anti-reflective spray

engenharia-reversa.title: Reverse Engineering & CAD Reconstruction
engenharia-reversa.headline: Transforming raw scan data into production-ready parametric solid models.
engenharia-reversa.overview: End-to-end engineering workflow to reconstruct 3D CAD models from physical parts lacking original drawings, exhibiting mechanical wear, or modified empirically in the toolroom.
targetAudience: Industrial plant maintenance needing replacement of obsolete legacy parts
Mining and agribusiness operations with imported heavy machinery
High-performance product and prototype developers
Tool and mold manufacturers needing original geometry recovery
applications: Parametric CAD modeling from polygon meshes (Mesh to CAD)
Recovery of worn or broken components with missing geometry reconstruction
Geometric adaptation for modernization and operational efficiency upgrades
Extraction of design intents, 2D cross-sections, and feature trees
deliverables: Parametric solid and surface CAD models in STEP, IGES, or Parasolid formats
2D manufacturing technical drawings in PDF and DWG with GD&T
CAD deviation report comparing reconstructed model against measured scan mesh

machines.name: ZEISS Reverse Engineering Ecosystem
machines.category: Specialized CAD Modeling & Reconstruction Software Suite
machines.accuracy: Class-A surfaces with G1/G2 curvature continuity
machines.sensor: Powered by 3D scan data from ZEISS ATOS Q and T-SCAN Hawk 2
features: Automatic surface segmentation for regular geometric entities (planes, cylinders, cones)
Precision freeform surface fitting with real-time residual deviation control
Native export compatibility with SolidWorks, Siemens NX, CATIA, and Autodesk Inventor
